title: Finding OR Sum
statementMd:
[*ALTER EGO - Yuta Imai vs Qlarabelle*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LJEqM7pvClA)

*This is an interactive problem.*

There are two hidden non-negative integers $x$ and $y$ ($0 \leq x, y \lt 2^{30}$). You can ask no more than $2$ queries of the following form.

- Pick a non-negative integer $n$ ($0 \leq n \lt 2^{30}$). The judge will respond with the value of $(n \mathbin{|} x) + (n \mathbin{|} y)$, where $|$ denotes the [bitwise OR operation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#OR).

After this, the judge will give you another non-negative integer $m$ ($0 \leq m \lt 2^{30}$). You must answer the correct value of $(m \mathbin{|} x) + (m \mathbin{|} y)$.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

## Interaction

Two hidden integers $x$ and $y$ are chosen ($0 \leq x, y \lt 2^{30}$). Note that $x$ and $y$ might be different for different test cases.

The interactor in this task is **not adaptive**. In other words, the integers $x$ and $y$ do not change during the interaction.

To ask a query, pick an integer $n$ ($0 \leq n \lt 2^{30}$) and print only the integer $n$ to a line.

You will receive a single integer, the value of $(n \mathbin{|} x) + (n \mathbin{|} y)$.

You may make no more than $2$ queries of the following form.

After you finish your queries, output "`!`" in a line. You will receive an integer $m$ ($0 \leq m \lt 2^{30}$). Note that the value of $m$ is also fixed before interaction.

You must output only the value of $(m \mathbin{|} x) + (m \mathbin{|} y)$ in a line. Note that this line is **not** considered a query and is **not** taken into account when counting the number of queries asked.

After this, proceed to the next test case.

If you make more than $2$ queries during an interaction, your program must terminate immediately, and you will receive the Wrong Answer verdict. Otherwise, you can get an arbitrary verdict because your solution will continue to read from a closed stream.

After printing a query do not forget to output the end of line and flush the output. Otherwise, you will get `Idleness limit exceeded`. To do this, use:

- `fflush(stdout)` or `cout.flush()` in C++;
- `System.out.flush()` in Java;
- `flush(output)` in Pascal;
- `stdout.flush()` in Python;
- see the documentation for other languages.

**Hacks**

To hack, follow the test format below.

The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first and only line of each test case contains a single line with three integers $x, y, m$ ($0 \leq x, y, m \lt 2^{30}$).

## Note

In the first test, the interaction proceeds as follows.

SolutionJuryExplanation$\texttt{2}$There are 2 test cases.$\texttt{}$In the first test case, $x=1$ and $y=2$.$\texttt{0}$$\texttt{3}$The solution requests $(0 \mathbin{|} 1) + (0 \mathbin{|} 2)$, and the jury responds with $3$.$\texttt{1}$$\texttt{4}$The solution requests $(1 \mathbin{|} 1) + (1 \mathbin{|} 2)$, and the jury responds with $4$.$\texttt{!}$$\texttt{1}$The solution requests the value of $m$, and the jury responds with $1$.$\texttt{4}$The solution knows that $(1 \mathbin{|} x) + (1 \mathbin{|} y)=4$ because of earlier queries.$\texttt{}$In the second test case, $x=0$ and $y=0$.$\texttt{0}$$\texttt{0}$The solution requests $(0 \mathbin{|} 0) + (0 \mathbin{|} 0)$, and the jury responds with $0$.$\texttt{!}$$\texttt{1}$The solution requests the value of $m$, and the jury responds with $1$.$\texttt{2}$The solution somehow deduces that $x=y=0$, so it responds with $(1 \mathbin{|} 0) + (1 \mathbin{|} 0)=2$.

Note that the empty lines in the example input and output are for the sake of clarity and do not occur in the real interaction.
statementZhMd:
[*ALTER EGO - Yuta Imai vs Qlarabelle*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LJEqM7pvClA)

*这是一道交互题。*

有两个隐藏的非负整数 $x$ 和 $y$（$0 \leq x, y \lt 2^{30}$）。你最多可以进行 $2$ 次如下形式的询问。

- 选择一个非负整数 $n$（$0 \leq n \lt 2^{30}$）。评测程序会返回 $(n \mathbin{|} x) + (n \mathbin{|} y)$ 的值，其中 $|$ 表示[按位 OR 运算](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#OR)。

之后，评测程序会再给你一个非负整数 $m$（$0 \leq m \lt 2^{30}$）。你必须回答 $(m \mathbin{|} x) + (m \mathbin{|} y)$ 的正确值。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

## 交互

会选定两个隐藏整数 $x$ 和 $y$（$0 \leq x, y \lt 2^{30}$）。注意，不同测试用例中的 $x$ 和 $y$ 可能不同。

本题的交互器**不是自适应的**。换句话说，在交互过程中，整数 $x$ 和 $y$ 不会改变。

要进行一次询问，选择一个整数 $n$（$0 \leq n \lt 2^{30}$），并单独输出一行整数 $n$。

你会收到一个整数，即 $(n \mathbin{|} x) + (n \mathbin{|} y)$ 的值。

你最多可以进行 $2$ 次上述形式的询问。

完成询问后，在一行中输出“`!`”。你会收到一个整数 $m$（$0 \leq m \lt 2^{30}$）。注意，$m$ 的值也在交互开始前就已固定。

你必须在一行中只输出 $(m \mathbin{|} x) + (m \mathbin{|} y)$ 的值。注意，这一行**不算作询问**，也不会计入询问次数。

之后，继续处理下一个测试用例。

如果在一次交互中进行了超过 $2$ 次询问，你的程序必须立即终止，并会收到 Wrong Answer 判定。否则，由于你的程序将继续从已关闭的流中读取数据，你可能会收到任意判定。

输出询问后，别忘了换行并刷新输出，否则会收到 `Idleness limit exceeded`。可以使用：

- C++ 中的 `fflush(stdout)` 或 `cout.flush()`；
- Java 中的 `System.out.flush()`；
- Pascal 中的 `flush(output)`；
- Python 中的 `stdout.flush()`；
- 其他语言请参阅相关文档。

**自定义测试**

自定义测试时，请遵循以下测试格式。

第一行包含测试用例数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例仅包含一行，其中有三个整数 $x, y, m$（$0 \leq x, y, m \lt 2^{30}$）。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，交互过程如下。

| 解法 | 评测程序 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| $\texttt{2}$ |  | 有 2 个测试用例。 |
| $\texttt{}$ |  | 在第一个测试用例中，$x=1$ 且 $y=2$。 |
| $\texttt{0}$ | $\texttt{3}$ | 解法询问 $(0 \mathbin{|} 1) + (0 \mathbin{|} 2)$，评测程序返回 $3$。 |
| $\texttt{1}$ | $\texttt{4}$ | 解法询问 $(1 \mathbin{|} 1) + (1 \mathbin{|} 2)$，评测程序返回 $4$。 |
| $\texttt{!}$ | $\texttt{1}$ | 解法请求 $m$ 的值，评测程序返回 $1$。 |
| $\texttt{4}$ |  | 由于之前的询问，解法知道 $(1 \mathbin{|} x) + (1 \mathbin{|} y)=4$。 |
| $\texttt{}$ |  | 在第二个测试用例中，$x=0$ 且 $y=0$。 |
| $\texttt{0}$ | $\texttt{0}$ | 解法询问 $(0 \mathbin{|} 0) + (0 \mathbin{|} 0)$，评测程序返回 $0$。 |
| $\texttt{!}$ | $\texttt{1}$ | 解法请求 $m$ 的值，评测程序返回 $1$。 |
| $\texttt{2}$ |  | 解法以某种方式推断出 $x=y=0$，因此回答 $(1 \mathbin{|} 0) + (1 \mathbin{|} 0)=2$。 |
